name: qkd_seq_core_st_r2

pin_regs.reason: All functional inputs are captured at their existing pin flops. Q store pushes use the compiled CMD timeline, and registered Q events are checked against its expected slots. Every external data/production edge is unchanged.

job.purpose: Q-KVSYS PVJOIN 10-16 (lead-approved qkd_seq retirement): static control leaf of qkd_seq_static. Every store pop / aq start / Q beat / posted row / stream descriptor at a fixed edge after the compiled CMD slot of the static D2D end (link compiler), arrivals off-slot fault, landing row credits only checked. Bench: qkd_seq_static (this leaf + closed qkd_seq_xs_tp8 x4 + qkd_seq_fan x4) vs legacy qkd_seq on 36 link-slotted layers: aq 1188 / kvn 72 / kc 72 words per quadrant bit-identical, aq start at the compiled CMD+47 every layer (legacy +1 edge earlier, rows equal); mutants Q-beat swap / row t / start late / KVN push early FAIL.

structural_change: Native capture defect repair: all att_rx inputs end at existing pin registers. Q pushes issue from cmd || (act && a<31), checking registered qev against act && a<32. Removes the raw att_rx_v/kind decode into x_v/x_cls (capture 207.57 ps, budget190). No state bits or production edges added; existing a comparator supplies 31/32-edge slot windows. Closed r1 view preserved.

reroute_reason.fix: Replace raw Q-kind-driven store pushes with CMD-compiled Q slots; registered events are checked against slots. No payload, issue or output edge changes.
